I've heard that putting hair down the drain can cause clogs, especially in older pipes or if there's a lot of hair. So, it makes sense to remove it and throw it away. But is the trash can the right place? I think about what happens when you put hair in the trash. It's biodegradable, so it shouldn't cause any issues in the landfill.
